rounds.q: What % of US adults own a smartphone?
rounds.why: 98% of US adults own some kind of cellphone.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Mobile Fact Sheet (2025)
rounds.fun: Nine in ten adults carry a smartphone. Check your pocket!

rounds.q: What % of US adults live in a home with no landline phone?
rounds.why: For kids it's even higher: 89% live in homes with only cell phones.
rounds.fun: Four in five adults live without a landline. Ring ring? Nope.

rounds.q: What % of US adults pay for cable or satellite TV at home?
rounds.why: It's 64% for adults 65 and older, but only 16% for ages 18 to 29.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Streaming and TV survey (2025)
rounds.fun: Only about a third of adults still have cable or satellite. Click!

rounds.q: Of US adults who stream shows, what % use a password from outside their home?
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Streaming and TV survey (2025)
rounds.fun: About one in four streamers borrows a login. Thanks for sharing!

rounds.q: What % of US adults listened to a podcast in the past year?
rounds.why: It's 67% for adults under 30 and 33% for those 65 and up.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Podcasts and News Fact Sheet (2025)
rounds.fun: Over half of adults pressed play on a podcast last year. Earbuds in!
